title: Matter
content: Matter is made up of tiny particles, and has mass and takes up space.
e: Matter is made up of tiny particles, and has mass and takes up space. Matter is anything that has mass and takes up space.

title: Brownian Motion
content: Brownian motion is the continuous random movement of small particles suspended in a gas or liquid, which arises from collisions with the gas or liquid particles.
e: Brownian motion is the continuous random movement of small particles suspended in a gas or liquid, which arises from collisions with the gas or liquid particles. Brownian motion is the random jiggling of tiny particles hit by fast molecules in a fluid.

title: Element
content: An element is a substance that cannot be broken down into other simpler substances through chemical means.
e: Element is defined as follows. An element is a substance that cannot be broken down into other simpler substances through chemical means. An element is a substance made of only one kind of atom.

title: Compound
content: A compound is a substance containing two or more different elements chemically joined together in a fixed ratio.
e: Compound is defined as follows. A compound is a substance containing two or more different elements chemically joined together in a fixed ratio. A compound contains two or more elements chemically joined in a fixed ratio.

title: Sublimation
content: Sublimation is the change of solid state directly into gaseous state without melting.
e: Sublimation is the change of solid state directly into gaseous state without melting. Sublimation is solid going straight to gas, or the reverse, without a liquid stage.

title: Solution
content: A solution is a clear homogeneous mixture obtained when a substance dissolves in a solvent, in which the solute is uniformly distributed throughout.
e: Solution is defined as follows. A solution is a clear homogeneous mixture obtained when a substance dissolves in a solvent, in which the solute is uniformly distributed throughout. A solution is a homogeneous mixture of solute dissolved in solvent.
